entries.headline: North Sea surveillance aircraft, US transports and coded broadcasts reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft over the North Sea, three heavy transport aircraft over the United States and an airborne nuclear command aircraft. It also reported two coded radio broadcasts heard that day, without providing their content or identifying specific flight missions.

entries.headline: War Watch relays German intelligence warning on Russia
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an Insider Paper report that Germany's foreign intelligence chief warned of an escalating shadow war with Russia. The post credited @reagan0965 and did not provide the warning's full details or independent confirmation.

entries.headline: North Sea surveillance aircraft and one recent coded broadcast reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported a US Air Force surveillance aircraft over the North Sea, four military transport aircraft airborne and one coded radio broadcast detected in the preceding hour. The post did not give the message content or specific flight missions.

entries.headline: HFGCS message header QHOIH6 reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported an Emergency Action Message header or preamble with code QHOIH6, tagged HFGCS. The post did not provide the message's full content or meaning; its displayed observation time had no stated timezone.

entries.headline: War Watch relays German intelligence warning on Chinese technology
entries.summary: War Watch Intel relayed an Insider Paper report that a German intelligence service warned of risks from Chinese technology. The post credited @reagan0965 without identifying particular products or giving the warning's full details.

entries.headline: Atlantic and North Sea transports; heightened Black Sea air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel described US military transport activity over the Atlantic and North Sea as unusually high and Black Sea air activity as nearly four times normal. It also mentioned multiple surveillance aircraft, without identifying the comparison period or specific missions.

entries.headline: Six transports over North Sea and Baltic reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne over the North Sea and Baltic. It described air activity near the Black Sea as nearly three times normal, without specifying a comparison period or the aircraft's missions.

entries.headline: Six simultaneous transports and increased Black Sea air activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US military transport aircraft airborne simultaneously and increased air activity in the Black Sea region. It also mentioned a recent US bomber withdrawal from England; the visible post did not give complete details or establish a connection to the flights.

entries.headline: Six transports and increased air activity near Black Sea and Korea reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six military transport aircraft airborne simultaneously and increased air activity near the Black Sea and Korea. It also relayed a claim that US bombers had been withdrawn from England after intelligence about an Iran threat, without establishing a connection to the reported flights.

entries.headline: US transports and surveillance aircraft; Eastern Mediterranean activity reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported multiple US Air Force transport aircraft airborne and surveillance aircraft sightings. It described Eastern Mediterranean military activity as 2.6 times normal, without identifying the comparison period or specific aircraft missions.

entries.headline: Six US transports, including one near Korea and Japan, reported
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported six US Air Force transport aircraft airborne simultaneously, including one near Korea and Japan. It also reported sightings of a surveillance aircraft, a nuclear command aircraft and a presidential aircraft, without identifying their specific missions or passengers.

entries.headline: War Watch reports bomber withdrawal from southern England
entries.summary: War Watch Intel reported that the US Air Force had withdrawn all bombers from southern England after intelligence warned of an Iran-backed plot targeting the base. The post did not name the base, give a withdrawal date or provide independent confirmation of the reported plot.

skyglass.caption: Military aircraft movement reports.

entries.headline: APACHE E-3 departure alert at Buin
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for APACHE, an E3CF airborne warning and control aircraft, at Buin, Chile. The post described its registration as United Kingdom, but did not confirm an operator, destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military P-8 at Orange Park, Florida. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 ground alert at Orange Park
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a US military P-8 Poseidon at Orange Park, Florida. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Isle of Lewis
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a UK-registered military P-8 at Isle of Lewis, United Kingdom. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 airborne alert near Fort St. John
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a US military P-8 near Fort St. John, Canada. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Lossiemouth
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a UK-registered military P-8 at Lossiemouth, United Kingdom. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: Australian P-8 ground alert at Misawa
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for an Australian-registered military P-8 Poseidon at Misawa, Japan. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a specific mission.

entries.headline: P-8 departure alert at Lossiemouth with placeholder callsign
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an OFF Ground alert for a UK-registered military P-8 Poseidon at Lossiemouth, United Kingdom. The callsign field showed only @ symbols; the post did not confirm the aircraft's identity, destination or specific mission.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares B-52 IRIS satellite communications upgrade report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report about an IRIS satellite communications system for the B-52 Stratofortress, described as supporting command and control beyond line of sight. The post did not provide a rollout date or independent confirmation of the reported upgrade.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares Montana Air Guard C-130J transition report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report that the Montana Air National Guard's 120th Airlift Wing had flown its last C-130H Hercules mission and was transitioning to the C-130J Super Hercules. The post did not give the final mission's date.

entries.headline: SkyGlass shares USS Ronald Reagan MQ-25 tanker readiness report
entries.summary: SkyGlass shared a Defence Blog report describing USS Ronald Reagan as the second US Navy carrier equipped to operate the MQ-25A Stingray drone tanker. The post did not confirm a deployment or an operational flight from the carrier.

entries.headline: E-3 AWACS ground alert near Lochem
entries.summary: SkyGlass issued an ON Ground alert for a Luxembourg-registered military E-3 TF AWACS aircraft near Lochem, Netherlands. No callsign was supplied, and the post did not confirm a specific mission or maintenance activity.
